Set up social media

Build profiles customers can trust. Consistent names, complete information, clear photos and one useful next step matter more than posting everywhere.

Set up social mediaBIZZINTEL · KEEP BUILDING
How to use this guide

Read one lesson, complete the action in your business, and keep the result somewhere you can find it. The examples are illustrations, not claims about real customers.

LESSON 01 / 06

Choose relevant channels

Not every business needs every platform.

What to do

  1. Identify where target customers already interact.
  2. Choose Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn or WhatsApp based on fit, not fashion.
  3. List the owner and posting responsibility for each account.
EXAMPLE / ILLUSTRATIVE

Illustrative: a consumer experience brand may prioritize Instagram and Facebook, while corporate wellness outreach may benefit from LinkedIn.

AVOID THIS

Creating five channels nobody will maintain.

↗
What you should finish with

Channel decision and username list.

Evidence to capture: Your written output or link to the relevant source
Optional: copy a ChatGPT prompt ＋

The lesson does not need AI. This prompt is only a writing aid.

For my business and audience, compare Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and WhatsApp Business by practical use, effort, content needs and call to action.
LESSON 02 / 06

Prepare your profile kit

Consistency reduces confusion.

What to do

  1. Use an accurate business name and consistent public contact details.
  2. Prepare real logo/cover photos, description, booking URL and hours.
  3. Keep account access and ownership documented securely, not in the public workbook.
EXAMPLE / ILLUSTRATIVE

Example to adapt: describe what a real customer would do or see at this step. Use actual facts for your business.

AVOID THIS

Claiming years of experience or credentials that cannot be verified.

↗
What you should finish with

A complete reusable profile-information sheet.

Evidence to capture: Your written output or link to the relevant source
Optional: copy a ChatGPT prompt ＋

The lesson does not need AI. This prompt is only a writing aid.

Draft a brand-safe profile kit with business name, short and long descriptions, services, audience, contact details, location, business hours and primary CTA. Leave unknowns blank.
LESSON 03 / 06

Build Facebook and Instagram

Visitors should know what you do immediately.

What to do

  1. Create or claim correct Meta business assets.
  2. Complete accurate descriptions, services, buttons and professional imagery.
  3. Publish an introductory post using HOOK → INFO → CTA.
EXAMPLE / ILLUSTRATIVE

Illustrative post: 'Bringing wellness to your doorstep. Choose your service and request availability. Message us to get started.'

AVOID THIS

Copying generic advice without checking that it fits your market, customer and costs.

↗
What you should finish with

Ready-to-review Facebook Page and Instagram profile checklist.

Evidence to capture: Your written output or link to the relevant source
Optional: copy a ChatGPT prompt ＋

The lesson does not need AI. This prompt is only a writing aid.

Draft a concise Facebook About section, Instagram bio, pinned introduction and three FAQ answers for this business, using only verified details.
LESSON 04 / 06

Set up LinkedIn appropriately

Useful for B2B credibility and partnerships.

What to do

  1. Decide whether LinkedIn serves a B2B goal.
  2. Use a genuine personal account to create/manage the Company Page.
  3. Complete specialties, verified website, tagline and team details.
EXAMPLE / ILLUSTRATIVE

Example to adapt: describe what a real customer would do or see at this step. Use actual facts for your business.

AVOID THIS

Copying generic advice without checking that it fits your market, customer and costs.

↗
What you should finish with

LinkedIn company-profile draft.

Evidence to capture: Your written output or link to the relevant source
OFFICIAL REFERENCELinkedIn official Page setup ↗
Optional: copy a ChatGPT prompt ＋

The lesson does not need AI. This prompt is only a writing aid.

Write a professional LinkedIn company description, tagline, specialties and first founder post without unverifiable achievements.
LESSON 05 / 06

Set up WhatsApp Business

Customers want simple ways to ask and book.

What to do

  1. Set up business category, services, hours and contact route.
  2. Create greeting, away message, saved FAQs and quick replies.
  3. Test from another phone and make sure a real human can respond.
EXAMPLE / ILLUSTRATIVE

Example to adapt: describe what a real customer would do or see at this step. Use actual facts for your business.

AVOID THIS

Promising 24/7 instant support without staffing it.

↗
What you should finish with

Messaging profile and reply scripts.

Evidence to capture: Your written output or link to the relevant source
Optional: copy a ChatGPT prompt ＋

The lesson does not need AI. This prompt is only a writing aid.

Draft a WhatsApp Business greeting, after-hours reply, FAQ responses and inquiry-to-booking messages for my services.
LESSON 06 / 06

Publish the first content

An empty profile feels unfinished.

What to do

  1. Create a HOOK → INFO → CTA structure for each post.
  2. Use actual product/service visuals, not invented proof.
  3. Publish a pinned offer, FAQ and introductory story before paid promotion.
EXAMPLE / ILLUSTRATIVE

Example to adapt: describe what a real customer would do or see at this step. Use actual facts for your business.

AVOID THIS

Copying generic advice without checking that it fits your market, customer and costs.

↗
What you should finish with

Seven starter posts and one-week content plan.

Evidence to capture: Your written output or link to the relevant source
Optional: copy a ChatGPT prompt ＋

The lesson does not need AI. This prompt is only a writing aid.

Create seven launch posts with a clear hook, useful information and next action. Use no invented reviews, results or client claims.
